issue.title: FAQ is not updated with Mockito 2 new features
issue.body:
The current [FAQ](https://github.com/mockito/mockito/wiki/FAQ) points that Mockito can't mock final classes or objects.
But [what's new](https://github.com/mockito/mockito/wiki/What%27s-new-in-Mockito-2#unmockable) point that can be done now.

One side-question: What about static methods and constructors? Still unmockable?

final: {"number": 919, "label": "docs", "route": "answer", "related": [657, 1013, 1105], "evidence": ["mockito/mockito-core/src/main/java/org/mockito/Mockito.java"], "reply": "Thanks for the report. The FAQ lives on the project wiki, which is not part of this source tree, so this reply covers what the shipped Javadoc says. Mockito.java already documents the Mockito 2 changes you mention. Section 39 (Mocking final types, enums and final methods) says final classes and methods can be mocked, using the inline mock maker, which has been the default since 5.0.0. Static methods are covered by Mockito.mockStatic (section 48, Mocking static methods). Constructors are covered by Mockito.mockConstruction, which also needs the inline mock maker. The FAQ entry that still says final classes can't be mocked is out of date and should be updated to match these sections."}
